_comment: COPY ME. Rename this file to keys.json and put it beside manganakama.exe (the same folder as prefs.txt and recent.txt) and these bindings load at startup. Nothing here is required — with no keys.json the built-in keys are all there is — and every line is an override you can delete.
_comment2: The set below is a CSP user's muscle memory: the shortcuts a mangaka coming from Clip Studio reaches for on day one and finds missing. Settings > Shortcuts edits the same file from inside the app, so you can start here and change it there.
_comment3: Spelling: "chord": "command". Modifiers in the order ctrl+shift+alt, then the key (a-z, 0-9, f1-f12, space, tab, enter, ...). The command must be a name the palette (Ctrl+K) knows; an unknown one is reported on the status line at startup instead of failing silently. A key beginning with _ is a comment lane, because JSON has none. A chord can also aim at a tool: see the manual's keys page for the "tool: ..." form and cycling arrays.
ctrl+2: Snap to special rulers (parallel, guide, symmetry)
shift+alt+e: Merge selected layers (combine the palette selection)
